_doc: Event calendar read by services/eventcal.py. Times are UTC. TM runs SESSIONS: a weekly or holiday occurrence is a season (Fri 12:00 + 72 h, or the day from 12:00) and the tournaments are the one-hour sessions inside it at 19:00 and 02:00 UTC (European and American evenings), each with its own rankings and prizes. An event that overlaps a weekly occurrence replaces that whole occurrence; one event at a time per game. TM missions are 'type:count': 0 combos (more than N), 1 perfect wins, 2 wins in a row, 3 Rotating Block conversions (more than N), 4 ties, 5 wins acting first, 6 Chance Block conversions (more than N); 7 (vs a Defense Up card) is not counted and is never set. TM prizes: money for 1st/2nd/3rd, cards for 1st/2nd/3rd, pack = PackPrm record for the cards, mission_money per cleared mission, class_money for the highest class reached (Bronze/Silver/Gold). Scaled 2026-10-03 to about a tenth: a cup paid more than a regular player earns in their whole career.
